Why Hannores

What You Get with Hannores

Checked Before Shipping, Covered After

Every red dot, magnifier, and weapon light is hand-checked—reticle, lens clarity, track alignment—before it leaves our warehouse. If anything ever slips through, we make it right on your next shipment. Your buyers stay happy, your inbox stays quiet.

Launch Your Own Brand from 50 Units

Build on our proven in-house models, or bring your own spec. Full OEM/ODM from 50 units—private-label logos, custom packaging, reticle design. We ship it under your brand, shelf-ready.

Pricing from the Source

We work directly with the factories—long-standing partners, not spot buys. Orders pooled across our B2B buyers keep pricing close to the source, with fewer layers between you and the line. Bring your list and compare—we welcome it. Customer-first, usually replies within 6 hours.

Inquiry & RFQ

Request Your Quotation Sheet

Tell us what you need. Our sourcing experts reply usually within 6 hours.

B2B Response Guarantee: Our sourcing experts will review your list and send a comprehensive, transparent PDF quotation sheet, usually within 6 hours.
